editorNote: A quiet day for the watchlist: the one fresh, verifiable item is an operating milestone at Rocket Lab. Other watchlist stories either repeat events already reported this fortnight or could not be confirmed from a readable source.

stories.headline: Rocket Lab flies its 100th Electron launch, and says it is the fastest commercial rocket to get there
stories.summary: Electron's 100th launch, 'The Mountain God Rises', lifted off from Launch Complex 1 in New Zealand on Nov. 14 and placed iQPS's YAMATSUMI-II radar-imaging satellite in a 575 km orbit. It was the 11th Electron launch for iQPS, which has seven more booked through 2030, and Rocket Lab says the next 100 launches are already booked.
stories.whyItMatters: The 'fastest commercial rocket to 100 launches' claim is Rocket Lab's own and was not independently verified; the page reports no share-price move for the launch.
